scope.budget: cooperative checks plus per-query two-second caps; use an external process timeout
scope.dev: four fixed held-out cases; no fitting or selection on dev
scope.ideal: evaluator-only gold-transform control after ordinary predictions
scope.repetition: parts repeat across scenes; neither epochs nor repeated parts are independent new meanings

source.reproducibility: scores/counts deterministic for matching source and dependencies; hashes identify but do not embed source; wall-clock timings are not deterministic
